category.zh: AI 用量 · 桌面工具

headline.zh:
让 AI 消耗，
变得一目了然。
headline.en:
Your AI usage.
Clearly in view.

summary.zh: 在菜单栏与系统托盘里，查看 Token 用量、缓存命中和已有配额记录。
summary.en: See token usage, cache hits and recorded quotas from your menu bar or system tray.

body.zh: 为每天使用 AI 编程工具的人做一个轻量的观察窗口。读取本机日志，按今日、7 天、30 天或全部查看用量，并将日志中提供的配额重置时间放到眼前。
body.en: A lightweight window into everyday AI coding. Read local logs, explore daily and longer-term usage, and see quota reset times supplied by those logs.

imageAlt.zh: TokenPulse Mac 原生面板，使用示例数据展示重置倒计时
imageAlt.en: Native TokenPulse Mac dashboard with illustrative usage and reset countdowns

imageNote.zh: 原生界面 · 示例数据

body.zh: 支持 Claude Code、Codex、Antigravity 和自定义 JSONL；Ollama 显示运行模型。
body.en: Supports Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity and custom JSONL. Ollama shows running models.

body.zh: 查看上下行、缓存、趋势与估算费用。时间未知的记录不参与实时告警。
body.en: Explore input, output, caching, trends and estimated cost. Undated usage does not trigger live alerts.

body.zh: 显示日志中已有的配额及重置时间，过期记录明确等待更新。
body.en: Shows recorded quotas and reset times, with an explicit pending state after expiry.

body.zh: Mac 菜单栏、Windows 系统托盘；关闭面板后继续后台运行。
body.en: Lives in the Mac menu bar or Windows tray and continues running when the panel closes.

downloadNote.zh: 预览版本。Mac 包为本地 ad-hoc 签名，未做 Apple 公证；Windows 包未做发布者签名。请确认版本和系统要求，校验文件可在对应 Release 查看。Windows 多屏缩放与托盘交互仍需实机验收。
downloadNote.en: Preview builds. The Mac app is ad-hoc signed and not notarized; the Windows package is not publisher-signed. Check system requirements and the checksums on each release. Windows mixed-DPI and tray interactions still need physical desktop validation.

category.zh: 个人财务 · 本地处理

headline.zh:
账单更有条理。
每一笔，都看得清。
headline.en:
Bring order to statements.
See every transaction.

summary.zh: 在浏览器或桌面整理信用卡账单，核对交易，并估算返现。
summary.en: Organize card statements, reconcile transactions and estimate cashback in a browser or desktop app.

body.zh: 从 PDF 或标准 CSV 中整理交易，再按商户、币种与收支筛选。支持结欠核对、自定义活动及本地加密保险库。网页版可直接用示例数据体验，无需准备真实账单。
body.en: Organize transactions from supported PDFs or standard CSV, then filter by merchant, currency and direction. Includes balance checks, configurable reward campaigns and a local encrypted vault. Try the browser version with sample data.

imageAlt.zh: CardPulse 网页版使用示例数据展示账单工作区
imageAlt.en: CardPulse browser workspace displaying sample statement data

body.zh: 导入受支持的 HSBC PDF 或标准 CSV，筛选交易并核对结单结欠。
body.en: Import supported HSBC PDFs or standard CSV, filter transactions and reconcile statement balances.

body.zh: 按渠道、日期、封顶与门槛配置活动；估算值需与银行条款核对。
body.en: Configure campaign dates, channels, caps and thresholds. Estimates need checking against bank terms.

body.zh: 用主密码加密保存记录。网页版与桌面版的数据不会自动互通。
body.en: Encrypt saved records with a master password. Browser and desktop data do not automatically sync.

body.zh: 点击“查看示例数据”探索工作区，CSV 导出与交易说明可直接体验。
body.en: Choose “View sample data” to explore the workspace, transaction explanations and CSV exports.

downloadNote.zh: 桌面版 v0.2.0。安装包尚未做发布者签名或 Apple 公证。网页版数据保存在当前浏览器与站点地址下，清除站点数据可能删除保险库，请先备份。仅在主动更新汇率时访问 Frankfurter，不发送账单内容。
downloadNote.en: Desktop v0.2.0. Packages are not publisher-signed or Apple-notarized. Browser data is tied to this browser and origin; clearing site data may remove your vault. Back up first. Optional rate updates contact Frankfurter without sending statement content.

category.zh: 技术阅读 · 日报与周报

headline.zh:
每天一点新发现。
每周，一个新视角。
headline.en:
A little discovery, daily.
A wider perspective, weekly.

summary.zh: 开源项目、开发者热议与严重安全公告，汇成可订阅的技术雷达。
summary.en: Open-source projects, developer conversations and critical security advisories in a subscribable digest.

body.zh: 把分散的信息汇成一处，保留原始来源。阅读每日汇编，回顾每周归档，或者订阅 RSS，在自己的阅读工具里持续跟进。
body.en: Bring scattered signals together while keeping original sources. Read daily briefs, browse weekly archives or follow along in your own RSS reader.

body.zh: 观察最近创建且获得关注的 GitHub 仓库，保留项目链接。
body.en: Discover recently created GitHub repositories gaining attention, with links to the projects.

body.zh: 汇集 Hacker News 热议与 GitHub 严重级别安全公告。
body.en: Collects Hacker News conversations and critical GitHub security advisories.

body.zh: 每日记录、按 ISO 周归档，方便回看一周的技术动态。
body.en: Daily records and ISO-week archives make it easy to look back at the week's signals.

body.zh: 通过标准 RSS 在自己的阅读工具里订阅，不需要账号。
body.en: Subscribe through standard RSS in the reader you already use, without an account.

category.zh: 基础设施 · 智能日志分析

headline.zh:
从异常日志，
走向排查线索。
headline.en:
From log anomalies
to investigation leads.

summary.zh: 面向 Elasticsearch 与混合基础设施的日志分析、AI 排查与告警平台。
summary.en: Log analysis, AI-assisted investigation and alerts for Elasticsearch and hybrid infrastructure.

body.zh: 对接已有日志基础设施，结合可配置模型与多步查询辅助排查，并提供通知与去重能力。适合需要自行部署、配置数据源和模型服务的开发者与运维团队。
body.en: Connect existing log infrastructure with configurable models and multi-step investigation, notifications and deduplication. For developers and operations teams managing their own data sources and deployment.

body.zh: 对接 Elasticsearch 与已有日志链路，支持多种索引方式。
body.en: Works with Elasticsearch and existing log pipelines across different index layouts.

body.zh: 支持模型开关与多步查询，帮助缩小异常排查范围。
body.en: Configurable models and multi-step queries help narrow an investigation.

body.zh: 按业务线配置告警，将排查结果送到已有协作工具。
body.en: Configure alerts by business line and deliver findings to existing collaboration tools.

body.zh: 需要服务器、数据源与访问控制；官网提供项目介绍和源码入口。
body.en: Requires server infrastructure, data sources and access control. This site provides an overview and source links.
